Ready — try the example.

States and behavior

Editable, read-only (selectable), disabled, password, and invalid with a connected explanation.

Keyboard

Native selection, clipboard, Home/End and text editing keys remain available. Enter submits.

Scope and adaptation

Do not intercept typing to implement application shortcuts. Validation appears beside the field and uses browser constraint validation.

Sources

Microsoft preliminary guide (1995), chapters 7–8

Original implementation; the page uses the shared GUI95 stylesheet with its 11px Tahoma stack. The 1995 source is preliminary, not a final product specification. Test the target browser and native host before shipping.
